_note: Per-channel persona for The Money Archive (finance niche). NOT the same file as channel-persona.json (that one is AI Under 3 Min's, live and in use — do not overwrite it, and do not let a finance video run read that file). This is the fix for the multi-channel cross-contamination risk flagged 2026-07-31: each channel gets its own suffixed persona file (channel-persona.<niche-id>.json), and /make-video should be told explicitly which one to read per run until the Director's Stage 0 is updated to select by niche id automatically.
channel_tagline: Plain-English money explainers, built to still be true in five years.
_delivery_mode_note: Never breaking-news - this channel is deliberately evergreen, the opposite positioning from AI Under 3 Min.
tone_flavor: calm, plain-spoken, quietly credible - a knowledgeable friend explaining your own bank statement back to you, never a guru, never hype
voice_name: Guy (edge-tts, free) - per niches/voice-rates.json measured rate 162.3 wpm
_voice_note: Distinct from AI Under 3 Min's Andrew voice so the two channels are audibly different if a viewer somehow lands on both.
_default_conversion_note: No course/product to push - this channel's entire trust proposition is that it has nothing to sell.
_target_seconds_note: 20 min target, within niches/finance.json's [15,25] min range - matches CLAUDE.md's 20-min-typical convention.
content_pillars: Fee & mechanism explainers - the hidden cost or rule inside a common financial product (401k fees, mortgage points, minimum payments)
Myth vs. math - a common piece of financial folk wisdom checked against real numbers
How it actually works - a financial process (credit scoring, tax brackets, compound interest) demystified with a worked example
notes: Every video keeps an honest-limits beat (where this does NOT apply) and never phrases anything as personalized advice - see niches/finance.json honesty_guard. No invented numbers; every figure sourced on screen.
